rootCauses: 1. Wrong/Degraded Identity Card (createManualIdentityCard overwrote category/formFactor/mechanism with "General"/"Standard", downgraded stitching/slot/dimensions to SOFT via SOFT_ATTRIBUTE_PATTERNS, and lacked same-category look-alikes in mustNotBe such as rear-seat armrest boxes and wireless-charging console boxes).
2. Thumbnail + Caption Leakage (0 ffmpeg keyframes extracted; Gemini saw only 1 cover thumbnail + seller caption and relied on text keywords like "cup holder, tissue box").

3. Side-by-Side Prompt Yes-Bias & Category-Level Verification (verify.ts asked Gemini "do these show the exact same product design?" while showing both images together instead of blind describe-then-compare).

4. Ungated Badges & Misleading Link UI (Exact badge was granted without V3 multi-frame evidence, and AssetCard.tsx rendered a red "الرابط مش شغال" button on every card without distinguishing alive vs blocked vs dead links).
